sources.title: Microsoft Copilot
sources.snippet: Microsoft Copilot is AI built to help you get things done. Create, brainstorm, learn, and solve problems with AI chat that works across your day.

sources.title: ChatGPT: Chat, Work, Create & Code with AI
sources.snippet: Use ChatGPT to answer questions, write, create images, complete work, and code—all in one place. Get started for free or download the app.

sources.title: Pill Identifier - Quickly Find and ID your Drugs (with pictures)
sources.snippet: Use our Pill Identifier tool to instantly match by imprint, shape, color, drug name, or NDC code. Access over 32,000 images, updated daily.

sources.title: Pill Identification Wizard from Drugs.com
sources.snippet: Use our Pill Identifier tool to quickly identify tablets and capsules using imprint codes, pill shape and color.

sources.title: Pill Identifier — Free FDA Imprint Search | MDFacts
sources.snippet: Pill Identifier Search by imprint, shape, or color against the FDA's Structured Product Labeling — the same authoritative source used by pharmacists.
